purpose: Connect matched CPU performance contrasts to derivative combinations on the same frozen policies.
status: Locally specified before these derivative outcomes; reuse of inspected training seeds; diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
generator: bounded positive wide stencil; backward Euler; nearest discrete action with lower index at ties
reference_policy: CPU greedy of shared initial function, tabulated once and shared by both evaluation designs and reference grids
mask: For each seed, common intersection over both meshes, both representations and all four steps: positive curvatures and interior greedy actions. Also report all-point clipped action error and mask counts.
statistics: Three quotient component RMS values, all cross terms, combined error, combined/component RMS ratio, update RMS and eta/S RMS. Report every seed; no expected direction imposed.
scope: Deterministic finite-reference diagnostics. Core error norms do not identify CE changes or the optimizer mechanism. Mesh differences are sensitivity measures, not bounds. No new training or CE-based selection.
